about_the_game:
There Is No Escape (TINE) Is a 2D Puzzle-platformer built in Clickteam Fusion 2.5.

STORY

Calvin, a 16-year-old boy, is working at 'The Facility' as a technician. His father used to work there as well before his death. Calvin wanted to find answers.

Everything he found pointed towards 'The Announcer' to be the one to blame for his father's death.

Using his hacking skills, he hacks into a robot that was scheduled to start a platforming testing track to try and get close to The Announcer without any danger to himself.

Eventually he teams up with someone named Lena to try and bring down the evil Announcer once and for all!

FEATURES

  • Retro Platforming - Experience the old platforming mechanics that were common with old flash games! Built for Keyboard and even Controllers!

  • Fully Voiced Story - Calvin, Lena, and The Announcer are fully voiced and ready to help expand the world of TINE.

  • Replayability - Each level has secrets, make sure to explore around, you never know what might affect your ending.

  • And much much more! - Play the game to find out additional exciting things that are featured in this game!
